reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in their direct message. I confirmed that their cutoff for the Quarrendon Freight Lines paperwork is now 7 July and that I'll keep it between us.

They said no action was needed, so I did nothing else. I didn't save the note to the shared knowledge base either, because other people can read it and Ilse asked me to keep this private. The note now exists only in their direct message with me.
